decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank (northern and southern) walls of the development hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The garage or car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. Front Parking Detail shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.

Condition : 8 - Notwithstanding the above, the single-storey rear extension hereby approved shall not project more than 4.1m from the main rear wall of the house including overhanging roof added to the rear wall of the extension, as shown on the proposed side elevations of drawing 02A dated May 2005 and received 16 May 2005.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the above, the width of the vehicular crossover shall be widened from 2m to 3m and a visibility splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension, first floor rear extesnion, 2 X rear roof and gable to hip roof extension to existing house and conversion of integral garage into a habitable room replacing garage door with a bay window (AMENDED DESCRIPTION)
